title: Triage X
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: After a terrorist attack kills his family and best friend, Arashi Mikami is saved by a surgeon who secretly leads Black Label, a team of hospital staff and local teenagers who kill criminals the law cannot reach. The team hunts arms dealers, corrupt politicians and gangsters, and the series mixes gunfights with heavy fan service.
life_message: Killing those judged to be society's 'cancers' is presented as a necessary cure when the law fails.
